method: dataprep/room_gt.py: laser stations inside the captured room, sharpest-histogram yaw, floor/ceiling = strongest horizontal planes, each main wall = strongest range^2-weighted plane in a manually chosen window (W:-0.58:-0.48,E:3.64:3.74,S:-0.84:-0.74,N:0.94:1.04)
note: Narrow furnished room; built-in wardrobe on the north-west and furniture along the south are not walls.
openings_method: dataprep/openings_gt.py: openings marked roughly on laser elevation images by a person, edges snapped to the laser wall (50 % solid-share crossing, 1 cm columns)
